name: dsh-setup
description: DSH web profile template — the deployable profile lives in profiles/web/. This root manifest deliberately declares NO plugin dependencies: duplicating them here is what drifted badly before (the old copy still pinned @snow-the/* at exact 0.1.x versions and shipped @liustack/modsearch, @anionex/dsh-vision-toolkit and @openviking/dsh-memory-plugin long after they were retired). profiles/web/package.json is the single source of truth; `pnpm check` asserts the template is self-consistent.
